blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: В ___ (кишечный) тракте человека живут миллионы полезных микроорганизмов.
exercises.prompt: Millions of beneficial organisms live in the human digestive tract.
exercises.why: Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending **-ой** if stressed: **новый** — **молодой**; **русский** — **плохой**, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension. All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify. — DLI, Lessons 46 and 47.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending **-ой** if stressed: **новый** — **молодой**; **русский** — **плохой**, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.

exercises.q: За ___ (последний) год интернет-покупки выросли на пятнадцать процентов.
exercises.prompt: Online purchases have increased fifteen percent over last year.
exercises.why: Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending **-ой** (**-ей**) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative. — DLI, Lessons 46 and 47.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
